entries.answer:
- **Claude Opus 5 (max)**: Anthropic; flagship frontier reasoning and agentic model; 1M context window (128K max output); pricing at $5.00 / $25.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[1][2][3][4]
- **Claude Fable 5 (with fallback)**: Anthropic; Mythos-class reasoning and multimodal model with Opus fallback integration; 1M context window; pricing at $10.00 / $50.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[3][5][6][7]
- **GPT-5.6 Sol (max)**: OpenAI; flagship multi-agent reasoning, deep coding, and autonomous workflow model; ~1.05M–1.1M context window (128K max output); pricing at $5.00 / $30.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[2][8][9][10][1]
- **Grok 4.6 (xhigh)**: xAI; real-time knowledge, high-speed coding, and agentic reasoning model; 500K context window; pricing at $2.00 / $6.00 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.50 cache hits).[4][8][11][2]
- **Kimi K3 (max)**: Moonshot AI; frontier MoE model specialized in deep reasoning, mathematics, and web development; ~1M–1.05M context window; pricing at $3.00 / $15.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[10][12][13][14]
- **GLM-5.3 (max)**: Zhipu AI (Z.ai); high-efficiency open-architecture reasoning and agentic model; 1M context window; pricing at $1.40 / $4.40 per 1M input/output tokens.[13][14][15][10]
- **Qwen3.8 Max**: Alibaba Cloud; 2.4T total parameter sparse MoE model (~95B active); 1M context window with multimodal (text, image, video) support; pricing at $2.00 / $6.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[14][15][16][10]
- **Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B**: Alibaba Cloud; explicit architecture configuration of Qwen3.8 Max featuring 2.4 trillion total parameters with 95 billion active parameters per token.[15][16]
- **Muse Spark 1.2 (xhigh)**: Meta; high-throughput coding and reasoning model with contributor tiering; ~1.05M (1,048,576) context window; pricing at $1.25 / $4.25 per 1M input/output tokens on OpenRouter.[17][18][19][20]
- **Gemini 3.7 Flash (high)**: Google; lightweight multimodal model supporting text, vision, audio, and video processing; 1M context window; pricing at $0.75 / $3.75 per 1M input/output tokens.[5][7][21][22]
- **DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (max)**: DeepSeek; checkpoint-specific frontier coding and terminal-execution MoE model; ~1.05M (1,048,576) context window; pricing at $0.66 / $1.98 per 1M input/output tokens.[18][19][20][17]
- **Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh)**: Alibaba Cloud; dense/compact open-weight model optimized for low-latency coding and agent tasks; Apache 2.0 license; pricing at $0.50 / $3.00 per 1M input/output tokens.[10]
- **Motif 3**: Motif AI; specialized enterprise workflow, structured data extraction, and process automation language model.
- **MiniMax-M3**: MiniMax; multimodal long-context MoE model built for agentic task completion and extended tool use.[15]
- **DeepSeek V4 Pro (max)**: DeepSeek; flagship large-scale sparse MoE reasoning model optimized for cost-effective software engineering and analytical workflows.[16][20][17]
- **MiMo-V2.5-Pro**: Xiaomi / MiMo AI; edge-to-cloud multimodal model tailored for device integration, personal assistant agents, and vision-language tasks.
- **Inkling**: Inkling AI; domain-specific creative synthesis, document comprehension, and interactive editing model.
- **Hy3**: Tencent / Hunyuan; foundation model focused on bilingual reasoning, enterprise search, and complex multi-turn dialogue.
- **Ling 3.0 Flash**: 01.AI (Ling); low-latency, high-efficiency distilled model optimized for rapid response generation and lightweight agent serving.
